units.source_text: 明石女御把筝让与紫夫人，将身子靠在席上休息了。

en.t: The Akashi consort handed the koto over to Lady Murasaki, then leaned back on the mat to rest.

units.source_text: 紫夫人便把和琴让与源氏，重新合奏，态度比初次随意不拘。

en.t: Lady Murasaki then gave the wagon to Genji, and they began playing together again, more relaxed and informal than at first.

units.source_text: 奏的是催马乐《葛城》，音节华丽悦耳。

en.t: They played the saibara piece Katsuragi, whose phrases were splendid and pleasing to the ear.

units.source_text: 源氏反复歌唱，其声婉转悠扬，美好无比。

en.t: Genji sang it again and again, his voice graceful, lingering, and incomparably beautiful.

units.source_text: 月亮渐次高升，梅花香色俱增，好一片牵惹人心的夜景啊！

en.t: The moon gradually climbed higher, the plum blossoms grew richer in fragrance and color, and the night scene was deeply enchanting.

units.source_text: 以前明石女御弹筝时，爪音优美可爱，又含有她母亲的古风，“由”音弹得很微妙，而又非常清澄。

en.t: Earlier, when the Akashi consort played the koto, the sound of her fingering was lovely and charming, with something of her mother's old-fashioned style, and her yu notes were subtle and exceptionally clear.

units.source_text: 现在紫夫人弹筝，又另有一种手法，从容不迫，婉转悠扬，似有一种魔力，能使闻者心驰神往。

en.t: Now Lady Murasaki played the koto with another kind of technique, calm, unhurried, and gracefully resonant, as if it had a magic power that carried listeners away.

units.source_text: “临”的手法也弹得比女御更有趣致。

en.t: Her handling of the rin technique was also more tasteful and engaging than the consort's.

units.source_text: 从吕调移到律调之后，诸乐器都变了调子。

en.t: After the music shifted from the ryo mode to the ritsu mode, all the instruments changed their tuning.

units.source_text: 律调的合奏非常娇媚华丽。

en.t: The ensemble in the ritsu mode was extraordinarily charming and brilliant.

units.source_text: 三公主弹七弦琴，五个调子弹出种种手法。

en.t: The Third Princess played the seven-stringed qin, displaying many techniques across five modes.

units.source_text: 其中最要当心的第五、六两弦的拨法，奏得非常巧妙。

en.t: Among them, her plucking of the especially delicate fifth and sixth strings was performed with remarkable skill.

units.source_text: 她的琴技全无稚气，已经十分成熟，能应用适合春秋万物的曲调而随机应变地作种种表现。

en.t: There was no childishness at all in her playing; it was already fully mature, and she could adapt melodies suited to the things of spring and autumn to express many moods as the moment required.

units.source_text: 她能确守源氏所教导的精神支配法。

en.t: She was able to follow exactly the discipline of spirit that Genji had taught her.

units.source_text: 因此源氏非常赞许她，并且觉得自己教导有方，十分得意。

en.t: Because of this, Genji praised her highly and felt quite pleased with himself for having taught her so well.

units.source_text: 几位小公子在廊下用心吹笛，吹得很好，源氏疼爱他们，说道：“你们想睡了么？

en.t: Several young noble boys were playing flutes attentively under the veranda and doing very well, and Genji, fond of them, said, Are you getting sleepy?

units.source_text: 今夜的音乐会，本想略奏片刻，不要延长时间，但因各个乐器各有其美，一经上手，欲罢不能。

en.t: For tonight's music gathering, I meant to play only briefly and not let it go on long, but each instrument had its own beauty, and once we began, we could not stop.

units.source_text: 我的耳朵又不灵敏，不能辨别孰高孰下，犹豫不决，以致延至夜深，实在很不应该。”

en.t: My ears are not very keen either, so I could not decide which was better or worse, and while I hesitated the night grew late, which was truly improper.

units.source_text: 便赐酒一杯与吹笙的小公子，即玉鬘所生长子，又在自己身上脱下一件衣裳来奖赏他。

en.t: He then gave a cup of wine to the young nobleman who had played the sho, Tamakazura's eldest son, and took off one of his own robes to reward him.

units.source_text: 紫夫人也把一件织锦的童衫和一条裙子赏给吹横笛的小公子，即夕雾的大儿子，但这并非正式赏赐，只是点景而已。

en.t: Lady Murasaki also gave a brocade child's robe and a skirt to the young nobleman who had played the transverse flute, Yugiri's eldest son, though this was not a formal reward but only a graceful touch for the occasion.

units.source_text: 三公主赐夕雾大将一杯酒，又赠自己所穿女装一套。

en.t: The Third Princess gave General Yugiri a cup of wine and also presented him with a set of women's robes she herself had worn.

units.source_text: 源氏笑道：“不行不行！应该先孝敬老师才对！我好懊恼啊！”

en.t: Genji laughed and said, No, no! You should honor your teacher first. How vexed I am!

units.source_text: 三公主座旁的帷屏背后便送出一支笛来，奉呈源氏主君。

en.t: From behind the curtain screen beside the Third Princess's seat, a flute was then brought out and respectfully presented to Lord Genji.

units.source_text: 源氏笑着接受了。

en.t: Genji accepted it with a smile.

units.source_text: 这是一支非常精美的高丽笛，源氏拿起来试吹一下。

en.t: It was an exceptionally fine Korean flute, and Genji picked it up and tried playing it for a moment.

units.source_text: 此时大家正在退出，夕雾听见笛声，便站住了，从儿子手中取过横笛来，吹出一支美妙的乐曲，非常动听。

en.t: At that moment everyone was withdrawing, but when Yugiri heard the flute, he stopped, took the transverse flute from his son's hand, and played a beautiful, deeply pleasing melody.

units.source_text: 源氏看见这些人个个本领高强，都能承受他的师传，便觉自己的才艺实在不易多得。

en.t: Seeing that each of them was highly skilled and able to inherit his teaching, Genji felt that his own artistic gifts were truly rare.
